title: LiouScope Run Manifest
description: Reproducibility manifest emitted on every diagnose() invocation.

run_id.description: SHA-256 deterministically derived from input_hash, seed and framework_version; two runs collide only when all output-affecting inputs match. Derivation is schema_version-scoped: run_id values are NOT comparable across differing schema_version (a bump changes the derivation domain), so a run_id archived under an earlier schema_version does not re-derive under this one.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 over every output-affecting input (Liouvillian, initial and steady states, time grid, bootstrap count, mpemba flag, solver path). Derivation is schema_version-scoped: the set of hashed inputs is fixed per schema_version, so input_hash values are NOT comparable across differing schema_version.
